title.zh: 卷一百〇四 志第五十二: 刑法三
title.raw: 卷一百〇四 志第五十二: 刑法三 Volume 104 Treatises 57: Punishment and Law 3

sentences.zh: 刑法三 ○食貨

translations.literal: Punishment Law 3 ○ Revenue and Commodities
translations.idiomatic: Punishment Law 3 — Revenue and Commodities

sentences.zh: 諸犯私鹽者，杖七十，徒二年，財產一半沒官，於沒物內一半付告人充賞。

translations.literal: As to all who violate the private-salt prohibition: beaten seventy strokes, penal servitude for two years, half their property confiscated to the state; of the confiscated goods, half is given to the informant as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever deals in illicit salt is beaten seventy strokes and sentenced to two years of penal servitude; half of their property is confiscated, and half of what is seized goes to the informant as a reward.

sentences.zh: 鹽貨犯界者，減私鹽罪一等。

translations.literal: Those whose salt goods cross the boundary line have the private-salt offense reduced by one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Salt sold across the monopoly boundary is punished one degree less severely than ordinary illicit salt.

sentences.zh: 提點官禁治不嚴，初犯笞四十，再犯杖八十，本司官與總管府官一同歸斷，三犯聞奏定罪。

translations.literal: If the intendant official does not strictly enforce the prohibition: first offense, forty strokes of the bamboo; second offense, eighty strokes of the staff; officials of the supervising office and the regional administration office judge together; on the third offense, report to the throne for sentencing.
translations.idiomatic: Intendants who fail to enforce the salt ban receive forty strokes of the bamboo on the first offense and eighty strokes of the staff on the second; their bureau and the regional administration judge the case jointly, and a third offense is reported to the throne for final sentencing.

sentences.zh: 如監臨官及竈戶私賣鹽者，同私鹽法。

translations.literal: If supervising officials or saltern households privately sell salt, the same applies as under the private-salt law.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising officials or saltern households who sell salt privately are punished under the same rules as other illicit salt dealers.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造鹽引者斬，家產付告人充賞。

translations.literal: As to all who forge salt permits: decapitation; family property given to the informant as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who forges a salt permit is decapitated, and their family property is awarded to the informant.

sentences.zh: 失覺察者，鄰佑不首告，杖一百。

translations.literal: Those who fail to detect it: if neighbors do not report first, beaten one hundred strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Neighbors who fail to report a forgery they should have noticed are beaten one hundred strokes.

sentences.zh: 商賈販鹽，到處不呈引發賣，及鹽引數外夾帶，鹽引不相隨，並同私鹽法。

translations.literal: Merchants who sell salt and everywhere fail to present the permit when selling, or carry beyond the permit's quantity, or do not keep the permit with the salt—all are treated as under the private-salt law.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants who sell salt without presenting their permit, exceed the permitted quantity, or fail to keep permit and salt together are all punished as illicit salt dealers.

sentences.zh: 鹽已賣，五日內不赴司縣批納引目，杖六十，徒一年，因而轉用者同賣私鹽法。

translations.literal: If salt has been sold and within five days one does not go to the prefectural or county office to cancel and return the permit: beaten sixty strokes, penal servitude one year; if the permit is thereby transferred for reuse, the same as selling private salt.
translations.idiomatic: After selling salt, failure to cancel the permit at the prefectural or county office within five days brings sixty strokes of the staff and one year of penal servitude; reusing the permit is punished like selling illicit salt.

sentences.zh: 犯私鹽及犯罪斷後，發鹽場充鹽夫，帶鐐居役，役滿放還。

translations.literal: After conviction for private salt or other offenses, send them to the saltern to serve as salt laborers, wear fetters and perform service; when service is complete, release and return.
translations.idiomatic: After sentencing for illicit salt or related crimes, offenders are sent to government salterns as bonded laborers in fetters and released when their term ends.

sentences.zh: 諸給散煎鹽竈戶工本，官吏通同克減者，計贓論罪。

translations.literal: As to all who issue working capital to boiling-salt saltern households: if officials collude to reduce it, calculate the embezzlement and sentence accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who collude to skim the working capital issued to saltern households are sentenced according to the amount embezzled.

sentences.zh: 諸大都南北兩城關廂，設立鹽局，官為發賣，其餘州縣鄉村並聽鹽商興販。

translations.literal: As to the northern and southern cities of the capital within the gates and wards: establish salt bureaus; the state sells; in other prefectures, counties, villages, and hamlets, salt merchants are permitted to trade.
translations.idiomatic: In the northern and southern wards of the capital, salt bureaus sell salt on the government's behalf; elsewhere in prefectures, counties, and villages, licensed salt merchants may trade freely.

sentences.zh: 諸賣鹽局官、煎鹽竈戶、販鹽客旅行鋪之家，輒插和灰土硝鹼者，笞五十七。

translations.literal: As to salt-bureau officials, boiling-salt saltern households, and traveling salt merchants and innkeepers who mix in ash, earth, or saltpeter: fifty-seven strokes of the bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: Salt-bureau officials, saltern households, traveling merchants, and innkeepers who adulterate salt with ash, dirt, or saltpeter receive fifty-seven strokes of the bamboo.

sentences.zh: 諸蒙古人私煮鹽者，依常法。

translations.literal: As to Mongols who privately boil salt: follow the ordinary law.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols who boil salt privately are punished under the ordinary statute.

sentences.zh: 諸犯私鹽，會赦，家產未入官者，革撥。

translations.literal: As to all who violate private-salt law and encounter an amnesty: if family property has not yet entered state custody, cancel and set aside.
translations.idiomatic: When an amnesty covers illicit-salt offenses, confiscation of family property not yet turned over to the state is waived.

sentences.zh: 諸私鹽再犯，加等斷徒如初犯，三犯杖斷同再犯，流遠，婦人免徒，其博易諸物，不論巨細，科全罪。

translations.literal: As to repeat private-salt offenses: on the second offense, increase the degree and sentence penal servitude as on the first; on the third, staff beating as on the second, exile to a distant place; women are exempt from penal servitude; for bartered goods, regardless of size, impose the full offense.
translations.idiomatic: A second illicit-salt offense increases the penalty to the same penal servitude as a first offense; a third brings staff beating and exile as on the second offense, though women are exempt from penal servitude. Goods exchanged in the trade, large or small, incur the full penalty.

sentences.zh: 諸轉買私鹽食用者，笞五十七，不用斷沒之令。

translations.literal: As to all who resell private salt for consumption: fifty-seven strokes of the bamboo; the confiscation statute does not apply.
translations.idiomatic: Those who buy illicit salt only for their own consumption receive fifty-seven strokes of the bamboo and are not subject to confiscation.

sentences.zh: 諸捕獲私鹽，止理見發之家，勿聽攀指平民。

translations.literal: As to all who seize private salt: only prosecute the household where it was discovered; do not allow implicating ordinary civilians.
translations.idiomatic: When illicit salt is seized, only the household where it was found may be prosecuted; informants may not implicate unrelated civilians.

sentences.zh: 有榷貨，無犯人，以榷貨解官；

translations.literal: If there are monopoly goods but no offender, surrender the monopoly goods to the authorities;
translations.idiomatic: If monopoly goods are found but no offender is identified, the goods alone are surrendered to the authorities;

sentences.zh: 無榷貨，有犯人，勿問。

translations.literal: If there are no monopoly goods but there is an offender, do not prosecute.
translations.idiomatic: if there is an offender but no monopoly goods, no case is brought.

sentences.zh: 諸巡捕私鹽，非承告報明白，不得輒入人家搜檢。

translations.literal: As to all who patrol and seize private salt: unless they receive a clear report and denunciation, they must not enter households to search.
translations.idiomatic: Salt patrols may not enter private homes to search unless they have received a clear and specific report.

sentences.zh: 諸犯私鹽，被獲拒捕者，斷罪流遠，因而傷人者處死。

translations.literal: As to all who violate private-salt law and, when seized, resist arrest: sentence and exile to a distant place; if they thereby injure someone, execution.
translations.idiomatic: Illicit salt offenders who resist arrest are sentenced and exiled; if anyone is injured in the struggle, they are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸巡鹽軍官，輒受財脫放鹽徒者，以枉法計贓論罪，奪所佩符及所受命，罷職不敘。

translations.literal: As to salt-patrol military officers who take bribes and release salt offenders: calculate embezzlement under the law of bending justice, strip the tally they wear and the commission they received, dismiss from office without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: Salt-patrol officers who accept bribes to release offenders are sentenced for corrupt justice according to the amount taken, stripped of their tally and commission, and permanently dismissed.

sentences.zh: 諸茶法，客旅納課買茶，隨處驗引發賣畢，三日內不赴所在官司批納引目者，杖六十；

translations.literal: As to the tea law: traveling merchants who pay duty and buy tea, wherever they verify the permit and finish selling, if within three days they do not go to the local office to cancel and return the permit: beaten sixty strokes;
translations.idiomatic: Under the tea regulations, traveling merchants who pay duty and sell tea must cancel their permit at the local office within three days of finishing sales, or receive sixty strokes of the staff;

sentences.zh: 因而轉用，或改抹字號，或增添夾帶斤重，及引不隨茶者，並同私茶法。

translations.literal: if the permit is thereby transferred, or characters and numbers are altered or erased, or extra weight is carried beyond the permit, or the permit does not accompany the tea—all are treated as under the private-tea law.
translations.idiomatic: reusing a permit, altering its numbers, carrying excess weight, or failing to keep permit and tea together is punished as illicit tea.

sentences.zh: 但犯私茶，杖七十，茶一半沒官，一半付告人充賞，應捕人同。

translations.literal: Whoever violates private-tea law: beaten seventy strokes; half the tea confiscated to the state, half given to the informant as reward; authorized catchers share equally.
translations.idiomatic: Illicit tea carries seventy strokes of the staff; half the tea goes to the state and half to the informant, with authorized catchers sharing the reward equally.

sentences.zh: 若茶園磨戶犯者，及運茶船主知情夾帶，同罪。

translations.literal: If tea-garden or grinding-house households commit the offense, or tea-transport ship masters knowingly carry extra beyond the permit, the same offense.
translations.idiomatic: Tea-garden and grinding-house operators, and transport ship masters who knowingly carry excess tea, receive the same penalty.

sentences.zh: 有司禁治不嚴，致有私茶生發，罪及官吏。

translations.literal: If officials do not strictly enforce the prohibition and private tea arises, the offense extends to the officials.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who fail to enforce the tea ban are punished when illicit tea appears in their jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 茶過批驗去處不批驗者，杖七十。

translations.literal: Those at transit verification stations who fail to verify passing tea: beaten seventy strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Officials at tea inspection stations who fail to inspect passing shipments receive seventy strokes of the staff.

sentences.zh: 其偽造茶引者斬，家產付告人充賞。

translations.literal: Those who forge tea permits: decapitation; family property given to the informant as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Forging a tea permit is punished by decapitation, with the forger's family property awarded to the informant.

sentences.zh: 諸私茶，非私自入山采者，不從斷沒法。

translations.literal: As to private tea: if one did not enter the mountains to gather it privately, the confiscation statute does not apply.
translations.idiomatic: The confiscation statute does not apply to illicit tea unless the offender gathered it privately in the mountains.

sentences.zh: 諸產金之地，有司歲征金課，正官監視人戶，自執權衡，兩平收受。

translations.literal: As to gold-producing regions: officials annually levy the gold tax; the chief official supervises households, who themselves hold the scales and receive payment fairly on both sides.
translations.idiomatic: In gold-producing districts officials levy the annual gold tax while the chief magistrate supervises households, who weigh and pay on fair scales themselves.

sentences.zh: 其有巧立名色，廣取用錢，及多秤金數，克除火耗，為民害者，從監察御史廉訪司糾之。

translations.literal: If they devise specious categories, broadly take fees, overweight the gold, or deduct refining loss to harm the people, the surveillance censor and surveillance commission shall investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who invent fees, overcharge, overweight gold, or skim refining loss to the people's harm are investigated by the surveillance censor and the surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 諸出銅之地，民間敢私煉者禁之。

translations.literal: As to copper-producing regions: if commoners dare to smelt privately, prohibit it.
translations.idiomatic: Private copper smelting is forbidden in copper-producing regions.

sentences.zh: 諸鐵法，無引私販者，比私鹽減一等，杖六十，錢沒官，內一半折價付告人充賞。

translations.literal: As to the iron law: those who sell privately without a permit, compared with private salt, reduce one degree: beaten sixty strokes; money confiscated to the state; of it, half converted to value and given to the informant as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Selling iron without a permit is punished one degree less than illicit salt: sixty strokes of the staff, confiscation of proceeds, and half the seized value paid to the informant.

sentences.zh: 偽造鐵引者，同偽造省部印信論罪，官給賞鈔二錠付告人。

translations.literal: Those who forge iron permits: sentenced as for forging provincial and ministry seals; the state gives reward notes of two ingots to the informant.
translations.idiomatic: Forging an iron permit is punished like forging a provincial or ministry seal; the informant receives two ingots of reward money from the state.

sentences.zh: 監臨正官禁治私鐵不嚴，致有私鐵生發者，初犯笞三十，再犯加一等，三犯別議黜降。

translations.literal: If the supervising chief official does not strictly prohibit private iron and private iron arises: first offense, thirty strokes of the bamboo; second offense, increase one degree; third offense, deliberate separately on demotion and dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Chief supervisors who fail to stop illicit iron trade receive thirty strokes of the bamboo on the first offense, a higher penalty on the second, and demotion or dismissal on the third.

sentences.zh: 客旅赴冶支鐵引後，不批月日出給，引鐵不相隨，引外夾帶，鐵沒官。

translations.literal: Traveling merchants who go to the smeltery to draw an iron permit and fail to have the month and day of issue recorded, or do not keep permit and iron together, or carry beyond the permit—the iron is confiscated to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants who obtain iron permits at smelteries but fail to record issue dates, keep permit and iron together, or stay within permitted quantities forfeit the iron to the state.

sentences.zh: 鐵已賣，十日內不赴有司批納引目，笞四十；

translations.literal: If iron has been sold and within ten days one does not go to the authorities to cancel and return the permit: forty strokes of the bamboo;
translations.idiomatic: After selling iron, failure to cancel the permit at the authorities within ten days brings forty strokes of the bamboo;

sentences.zh: 因而轉用，同私鐵法。

translations.literal: if the permit is thereby transferred for reuse, the same as under the private-iron law.
translations.idiomatic: reusing the permit is punished under the illicit-iron statute.

sentences.zh: 凡私鐵農器鍋釜刀鐮斧杖及破壞生熟鐵器，不在禁限。

translations.literal: As to private iron in farm tools, pots, knives, sickles, axes, staves, and broken raw or finished iron implements—not within the prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: Farm tools, pots, knives, sickles, axes, staves, and scrap iron are not subject to the iron monopoly ban.

sentences.zh: 江南鐵貨及生熟鐵器，不得於淮、漢以北販賣，違者以私鐵論。

translations.literal: Jiangnan iron goods and raw or finished iron implements may not be sold north of the Huai and Han rivers; violators are sentenced as for private iron.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan iron and iron goods may not be sold north of the Huai and Han; violators are punished as illicit iron dealers.

sentences.zh: 諸衛輝等處販賣私竹者，竹及價錢並沒官，首告得實者，於沒官物約量給賞。

translations.literal: As to Weihui and other places where private bamboo is sold: bamboo and purchase money are both confiscated to the state; if the first informant's report is verified, reward is given proportionally from the confiscated goods.
translations.idiomatic: At Weihui and similar districts, illicit bamboo and its proceeds are confiscated; verified first informants receive a proportional reward from what is seized.

sentences.zh: 犯界私賣者，減私竹罪一等。

translations.literal: Those who sell privately across the boundary have the private-bamboo offense reduced by one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Bamboo sold across the monopoly boundary is punished one degree less than ordinary illicit bamboo.

sentences.zh: 若民間住宅內外並闌檻竹不成畝，本主自用外貨賣者，依例抽分。

translations.literal: If bamboo inside and outside commoners' dwellings and on railings does not amount to a full mu, and beyond the owner's own use he sells it: levy the statutory share.
translations.idiomatic: Bamboo on private dwellings and railings amounting to less than a mu may be sold beyond the owner's own needs subject to the statutory levy.

sentences.zh: 有司禁治不嚴者罪之，仍於解由內開寫。

translations.literal: Officials who do not strictly enforce the prohibition are punished; it is still to be recorded in the credentials for transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who fail to enforce the bamboo regulations are punished, and the offense is entered on their transfer credentials.

sentences.zh: 諸私造唆魯麻酒者，同私酒法，杖七十，徒二年，財產一半沒官，有首告者，於沒官物內一半給賞。

translations.literal: As to all who privately brew araq: the same as the private-liquor law—beaten seventy strokes, penal servitude two years, half the property confiscated to the state; if there is a first informant, half of the confiscated goods is given as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Private brewing of araq is punished like illicit liquor: seventy strokes of the staff, two years of penal servitude, half the property confiscated, and half the seizure given to a first informant.

sentences.zh: 諸蒙古、漢軍輒醞造私酒醋曲者，依常法。

translations.literal: As to Mongols and Han army households who brew private liquor, vinegar, or yeast: follow the ordinary law.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols and Han military households who brew private liquor, vinegar, or yeast are punished under the ordinary statute.

sentences.zh: 諸犯禁飲私酒者，笞三十七。

translations.literal: As to all who violate the prohibition by drinking private liquor: thirty-seven strokes of the bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: Drinking illicit liquor in violation of the ban brings thirty-seven strokes of the bamboo.

sentences.zh: 諸犯界酒，十瓶以下，罰中統鈔一十兩，笞二十，七十瓶以上，罰鈔四十兩，笞四十七，酒給元主。

translations.literal: As to all who violate the liquor boundary: ten bottles or fewer—fine ten liang of zhongtong notes, twenty strokes of the bamboo; seventy bottles or more—fine forty liang of notes, forty-seven strokes of the bamboo; the liquor is given to the original owner.
translations.idiomatic: Liquor sold across the monopoly boundary: ten bottles or fewer draws a fine of ten liang of zhongtong notes and twenty strokes of the bamboo; seventy bottles or more draws forty liang and forty-seven strokes, with the liquor returned to the original owner.

sentences.zh: 酒雖多，罰止五十兩，罪止六十。

translations.literal: However much the liquor, the fine stops at fifty liang; the punishment stops at sixty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: No matter how much liquor is involved, the fine is capped at fifty liang and the beating at sixty strokes.

sentences.zh: 諸匿稅者，物貨一半沒官，於沒官物內一半付告人充賞，但犯笞五十，入門不吊引，同匿稅法。

translations.literal: As to all who evade tax: half the goods confiscated to the state; of the confiscated goods, half given to the informant as reward; whoever commits it—fifty strokes of the bamboo; entering a gate without presenting the transit permit—same as the tax-evasion law.
translations.idiomatic: Tax evaders forfeit half their goods to the state and half of that to the informant, with fifty strokes of the bamboo; entering a gate without a transit permit is punished the same way.

sentences.zh: 諸辦課官，估物收稅而輒抽分本色者，禁之。

translations.literal: As to all tax-collection officials who assess goods and collect tax yet take a share of the goods in kind: prohibit it.
translations.idiomatic: Tax officials who skim goods in kind while assessing and collecting duties are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 其監臨官吏輒於稅課務求索什物者，以盜官物論，取與同坐。

translations.literal: If supervising officials demand sundry goods at tax offices: sentence as for stealing state property; giver and receiver share the offense.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising officials who demand goods at tax offices are sentenced for stealing state property, and both giver and receiver are punished.

sentences.zh: 諸辦課官所掌應稅之物，並三十分中取一，輒冒估直，多收稅錢，別立名色，巧取分例，及不應收稅而收稅者，各以其罪罪之，廉訪司常加體察。

translations.literal: As to all taxable goods under tax officials' charge, of which one part in thirty is taken: if they falsely inflate value, collect excess tax money, establish separate categories, craftily take shares, or tax what should not be taxed—each is sentenced for his offense; the surveillance commission shall constantly investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Tax officials who inflate valuations, overcharge, invent fees, take illicit shares, or tax exempt goods are each sentenced accordingly; the surveillance commission is to investigate them regularly.

sentences.zh: 諸在城及鄉村有市集之處，課稅有常法。

translations.literal: As to all places in cities and villages where markets exist: commodity tax has fixed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed commodity-tax rules apply wherever markets exist in cities and villages.

sentences.zh: 其在城稅務官吏，輒於鄉村妄執經過商賈匿稅者，禁之。

translations.literal: If urban tax officials in villages arbitrarily detain passing merchants for alleged tax evasion: prohibit it.
translations.idiomatic: Urban tax officials are forbidden to detain passing merchants in villages on false charges of tax evasion.

sentences.zh: 諸辦課官，侵用增余稅課者，以不枉法贓論罪。

translations.literal: As to all tax officials who appropriate surplus tax revenue: sentence as for embezzlement without bending justice.
translations.idiomatic: Tax officials who appropriate surplus revenue are sentenced for non-corrupt embezzlement.

sentences.zh: 諸職官，印契不納稅錢者，計應納稅錢，以不枉法論。

translations.literal: As to all officials who on deeds and contracts fail to pay tax money: calculate the tax that should have been paid and sentence as for non-corrupt offense.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who fail to pay deed taxes are sentenced for a non-corrupt offense according to the amount owed.

sentences.zh: 諸市舶金銀銅錢鐵貨、男女人口、絲綿段匹、銷金綾羅、米糧軍器等，不得私販下海，違者舶商、船主、綱首、事頭、火長各杖一百七，船物沒官，有首告者，以沒官物內一半充賞，廉訪司常加糾察。

translations.literal: As to maritime-trade gold, silver, copper cash, iron goods, male and female persons, silk and cotton fabrics, gilded brocades, grain, military equipment, and the like: they may not be privately sold and sent to sea; violators—the merchant, ship master, convoy chief, business head, and fire-room chief—each beaten one hundred seven strokes; ship and goods confiscated to the state; if there is a first informant, half of the confiscated goods as reward; the surveillance commission shall constantly investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Gold, silver, coin, iron, people, silk, brocade, grain, and military goods may not be smuggled overseas; the merchant, master, convoy chief, business head, and fire-room chief each receive one hundred seven strokes, with ship and cargo confiscated and half given to a first informant; the surveillance commission is to investigate constantly.

sentences.zh: 諸市舶司於回帆物內，三十分抽稅一分，輒以非理受財者，計贓，以枉法論。

translations.literal: As to the maritime-trade office on returning cargo: of thirty parts, one part is taxed; if they improperly take property: calculate embezzlement and sentence as for bending justice.
translations.idiomatic: Maritime-trade officials who take improper payments on returning cargo taxed at one part in thirty are sentenced for corrupt justice according to the amount taken.

sentences.zh: 諸舶商、大船給公驗，小船給公憑，每大船一，帶柴水船、八櫓船各一，驗憑隨船而行。

translations.literal: As to all maritime merchants: large ships are given a public verification, small ships a public credential; for each large ship, one fuel-and-water tender and one eight-oar tender are attached; verification and credential travel with the ship.
translations.idiomatic: Large merchant vessels receive a public verification and small vessels a public credential; each large ship must have one fuel tender and one eight-oar tender, and the documents must travel with the ship.

sentences.zh: 或有驗無憑，及數外夾帶，即同私販，犯人杖一百七，船物並沒官，內一半付告人充賞。

translations.literal: If there is verification but no credential, or cargo beyond the permitted quantity is carried, it is the same as private trade: offender beaten one hundred seven strokes; ship and goods all confiscated to the state; of them, half given to the informant as reward.
translations.idiomatic: A verification without its matching credential, or cargo beyond the permitted amount, is treated as smuggling: one hundred seven strokes, confiscation of ship and goods, and half the seizure paid to the informant.

sentences.zh: 公驗內批寫物貨不實，及轉變滲泄作弊，同漏舶法，杖一百七，財物沒官；

translations.literal: If goods recorded in the public verification are false, or goods are diverted, leaked, or fraudulently manipulated—the same as the law on evading the maritime office: beaten one hundred seven strokes, property confiscated to the state;
translations.idiomatic: False entries on a public verification, or diverting, leaking, or cheating on cargo, is punished like evading the maritime office: one hundred seven strokes and confiscation of property;

sentences.zh: 舶司官吏容隱，斷罪不敘。

translations.literal: if maritime-office officials conceal it: sentence and no reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: maritime-office officials who conceal such offenses are sentenced and permanently barred from office.

sentences.zh: 諸番國遣使奉貢，仍具貢物，報市舶司稱驗，若有夾帶，不與抽分者，以漏舶論。

translations.literal: As to all foreign states sending envoys with tribute, still listing tribute goods and reporting to the maritime-trade office for weighing and verification: if extra goods are carried beyond and no share is levied, sentence as for evading the maritime office.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute envoys from foreign states must declare their goods to the maritime-trade office for inspection; undeclared goods on which no tax is paid are punished as smuggling.

sentences.zh: 諸海門鎮守軍官，輒與番邦回舶頭目等人，通情滲泄舶貨者，杖一百七，除名不敘。

translations.literal: As to all sea-gate garrison military officers who collude with foreign returning-ship leaders and others to leak maritime cargo: beaten one hundred seven strokes, name removed and no reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison officers at the sea gates who collude with foreign ship captains to leak cargo receive one hundred seven strokes and are permanently struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 諸中賣寶貨，耗蠹國財者，禁之。

translations.literal: As to all who sell precious goods at court and drain state wealth: prohibit it.
translations.idiomatic: Selling precious goods at court in ways that drain state wealth is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸雲南行使<貝卜>法，官司商賈輒以他<貝卜>入境者，禁之。

translations.literal: As to Yunnan, where shell currency is used by law: if officials or merchants bring other shell currency into the region: prohibit it.
translations.idiomatic: In Yunnan, where shell currency is the legal medium, officials and merchants are forbidden to bring foreign shell currency into the province.

sentences.zh: ○大惡

translations.literal: ○ Great Wickedness
translations.idiomatic: ○ Capital Offenses

sentences.zh: 諸大臣謀危社稷者誅。

translations.literal: As to all great ministers who plot to endanger the altars of soil and grain: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Great ministers who plot to endanger the state are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸無故議論謀逆，為倡者處死，和者流。

translations.literal: As to all who without cause discuss plotting rebellion: the instigator is executed, accomplices are exiled.
translations.idiomatic: Those who without cause discuss treason are punished: the ringleader is executed and followers are exiled.

sentences.zh: 諸潛謀反亂者處死，宅主及兩鄰知而不首者同罪，內能悔過自首者免罪給賞，不應捕人首告者官之。

translations.literal: As to all who secretly plot rebellion or disorder: execution; the householder and neighbors on both sides who know but do not report first share the offense; among them, those who repent and surrender themselves are exempted and given reward; if someone not authorized to arrest reports first, appoint him to office.
translations.idiomatic: Secret plotting of rebellion or disorder is punishable by death; householders and both neighbors who know but fail to report share the guilt. Those who repent and surrender are pardoned and rewarded, and unauthorized informants who report first may be given office.

sentences.zh: 諸謀反已有反狀，為首及同情者淩遲處死，為從者處死，知情不首者減為從一等流遠，並沒入其家。

translations.literal: As to all who plot rebellion when overt signs of rebellion already exist: ringleaders and sympathizers are executed by dismemberment; followers are executed; those who know but do not report first have the follower offense reduced one degree and are exiled to a distant place; their households are all confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: When treason has already taken overt form, ringleaders and sympathizers suffer dismemberment, followers are executed, and those who knew but failed to report are exiled one degree below followers with their households confiscated.

sentences.zh: 其相須連坐者，各以其罪罪之。

translations.literal: Those mutually implicated in shared punishment are each sentenced for his own offense.
translations.idiomatic: Those implicated together are each sentenced according to his own offense.

sentences.zh: 諸父謀反，子異籍不坐。

translations.literal: As to all cases where the father plots rebellion: if the son is on a separate household register, he is not implicated.
translations.idiomatic: When a father plots treason, a son registered on a separate household roll is not implicated.

sentences.zh: 諸謀反事覺，捕治得實，行省不得擅行誅殺，結案待報。

translations.literal: As to all treason cases when the matter comes to light, arrest and punishment are verified: regional secretariats must not on their own authority carry out execution; close the case and await report.
translations.idiomatic: When treason is discovered and verified, regional secretariats may not execute offenders on their own authority but must close the case and await imperial orders.

sentences.zh: 諸匿反叛不首者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who conceal rebels and do not report: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who conceal rebels without reporting them are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸妖言惑眾，嘯聚為亂，為首及同謀者處死，沒入其家；

translations.literal: As to all who use demonic speech to delude the masses and gather in uproar to make disorder: ringleaders and co-conspirators are executed, their households confiscated;
translations.idiomatic: Those who spread sorcery or sedition to delude the people and gather in armed disorder are executed and their households confiscated;

sentences.zh: 為所誘惑相連而起者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: those who were enticed and rose together in succession: beaten one hundred seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: those who were merely enticed into joining receive one hundred seven strokes of the staff.

sentences.zh: 諸假托神異，狂謀犯上者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who falsely claim divine wonders and madly plot offense against superiors: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who falsely claim supernatural powers and plot madly against their superiors are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸亂言犯上者處死，仍沒其家。

translations.literal: As to all who speak disorderly words offending superiors: execution; still confiscate the household.
translations.idiomatic: Those who speak seditiously against their superiors are executed and their households confiscated.

sentences.zh: 諸指斥乘輿者，非特恩，必坐之。

translations.literal: As to all who point at and reproach the imperial carriage: unless there is special grace, they must be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who insult the emperor's person or carriage are punished unless specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 諸妄撰詞曲，誣人以犯上惡言者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who falsely compose lyrics and songs to slander others with words of offense against superiors: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who compose false songs or verses to accuse others of seditious speech are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸職官輒指斥詔旨亂言者，雖會赦，仍除名不敘。

translations.literal: As to all officials who point at and reproach imperial edicts with disorderly speech: even if an amnesty is encountered, still remove their names and grant no reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who insult imperial edicts with disorderly speech are struck from the rolls without reinstatement even when an amnesty is proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 諸子孫弒其祖父母、父母者，陵遲處死，因風狂者處死。

translations.literal: As to all descendants who murder their grandparents or parents: executed by dismemberment; if due to wind madness, still execution.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants who murder grandparents or parents suffer dismemberment; even if driven by madness, they are still executed.

sentences.zh: 諸醉後毆其父母，父母無他子，告乞免死養老者，杖一百七，居役百日。

translations.literal: As to all who when drunk beat their parents, and the parents have no other sons and petition to spare death for support in old age: beaten one hundred seven strokes, perform service for one hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: Those who beat their parents while drunk, when the parents have no other sons and plead for the offender's life to support them in old age, receive one hundred seven strokes and one hundred days of penal service.

sentences.zh: 諸子弒其繼母者，與嫡母同。

translations.literal: As to all sons who murder their stepmother: the same as for the principal mother.
translations.idiomatic: Sons who murder a stepmother are punished the same as for murdering a principal mother.

sentences.zh: 諸部內有犯惡逆，而鄰佑、社長知而不首，有司承告而不問，皆罪之。

translations.literal: As to all cases within a ward where the offense of great wickedness is committed, yet neighbors and the hamlet chief know but do not report first, or officials receive denunciation but do not investigate—all are punished.
translations.idiomatic: When capital parricide occurs in a ward, neighbors and hamlet chiefs who fail to report, and officials who ignore denunciations, are all punished.

sentences.zh: 諸子弒其父母，雖瘐死獄中，仍支解其屍以徇。

translations.literal: As to all sons who murder their parents: even if they die of illness in prison, still dismember the corpse and display it as warning.
translations.idiomatic: Sons who murder their parents, even if they die of illness in prison, still have their corpses dismembered and displayed as a warning.

sentences.zh: 諸毆傷祖父母、父母者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who beat and injure grandparents or parents: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who beat and injure grandparents or parents are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸謀殺已改嫁祖母者，仍以惡逆論。

translations.literal: As to all who plot to murder a grandmother who has remarried: still sentenced as for great wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Plotting to murder a remarried grandmother is still punished as capital parricide.

sentences.zh: 諸挾仇毆死義父，及殺傷幸獲生免者，皆處死。

translations.literal: As to all who bearing a grudge beat to death a foster father, or kill or injure and fortunately obtain life spared: all are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Those who kill a foster father in a grudge beating, or who kill or injure him even if he survives, are all executed.

sentences.zh: 諸圖財殺傷義母者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who seeking property kill or injure a foster mother: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who kill or injure a foster mother for her property are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸為人子孫，或因貧困，或信巫覡說誘，發掘祖宗墳墓，盜其財物，賣其塋地者，驗輕重斷罪：移棄屍骸，不為祭祀者，同惡逆結案。

translations.literal: As to all who as descendants, whether from poverty or believing shaman and sorcerer persuasion, excavate ancestral graves, steal the goods, and sell the burial ground: examine severity and sentence; if corpses are moved and abandoned and no sacrifices are performed, close the case as for great wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants who excavate ancestral graves from poverty or sorcerers' persuasion, steal grave goods, or sell burial land are sentenced according to severity; moving or abandoning corpses and ending sacrifices is closed as capital parricide.

sentences.zh: 買者知情，減犯人罪二等，價錢沒官；

translations.literal: If the buyer knew: reduce the offender's offense two degrees; purchase money confiscated to the state;
translations.idiomatic: Knowing buyers have the offense reduced two degrees, with the purchase price confiscated;

sentences.zh: 不知情，臨事詳審，有司仍不得出給賣墳地公據。

translations.literal: if ignorant, examine in detail at the time; officials still must not issue public credentials for selling grave land.
translations.idiomatic: if ignorant, the case is examined in detail, but officials still may not issue public deeds for grave-land sales.

sentences.zh: 諸為人子孫，為首同他盜發掘祖宗墳墓，盜取財物者，以惡逆論，雖遇大赦原免，仍刺字徙遠方屯種。

translations.literal: As to all who as descendants lead others in robbery to excavate ancestral graves and steal goods: sentenced as for great wickedness; even if a great amnesty would ordinarily remit, still tattoo and exile to a distant place for military colony farming.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants who lead others in robbing ancestral graves are sentenced as capital parricide; even under a great amnesty they are tattooed and exiled to distant military colonies.

sentences.zh: 諸婦毆舅姑者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all wives who beat their husband's parents: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Wives who beat their parents-in-law are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸因奸毆死其夫及其舅姑者，陵遲處死。

translations.literal: As to all who through adultery beat to death their husband and his parents: executed by dismemberment.
translations.idiomatic: Women who beat their husband and parents-in-law to death in an adulterous affair suffer dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 諸弟殺其兄者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all younger brothers who kill their elder brother: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brothers who kill an elder brother are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸父子同謀殺其兄，欲圖其財而收其嫂者，父子並淩遲處死。

translations.literal: As to all cases where father and son jointly plot to kill their elder brother to seize his property and take his widow: father and son are both executed by dismemberment.
translations.idiomatic: If father and son conspire to murder their elder brother for his estate and widow, both suffer dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 諸兄因爭，毆其弟，弟還毆其兄，邂逅致死，會赦，仍以故殺論。

translations.literal: As to all cases where an elder brother in a quarrel beats his younger brother, the younger beats back, and chance encounter causes death: even if an amnesty is encountered, still sentence as for intentional killing.
translations.idiomatic: When brothers quarrel and the younger strikes back and accidentally kills the elder, the offense is still treated as intentional homicide even under an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 諸嫂叔爭，殺死其嫂者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all cases where a sister-in-law and her husband's younger brother quarrel and he kills the sister-in-law: execution.
translations.idiomatic: If a sister-in-law and her husband's younger brother quarrel and he kills her, he is executed.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭虐殺其兄者，雖死仍戮其屍。

translations.literal: As to all who in a quarrel cruelly kill their elder brother: even if dead, still mutilate the corpse.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever cruelly kills an elder brother in a quarrel has his corpse mutilated even if he has already died.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭移怒，戳傷其兄者，於市曹杖一百七，流遠。

translations.literal: As to all who in a quarrel redirect anger and stab and injure their elder brother: at the execution ground, beaten one hundred seven strokes, exiled to a distant place.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever stabs and wounds an elder brother in a quarrel receives one hundred seven strokes at the execution ground and is exiled afar.

sentences.zh: 諸挾仇毆死其伯叔母者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who bearing a grudge beat to death their aunt by marriage: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who beat an uncle's wife to death in a grudge killing are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭兄弟同謀毆死諸父者，皆處死。

translations.literal: As to all brothers who in a quarrel jointly plot to beat to death their fathers: all are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Brothers who in a quarrel jointly beat their fathers to death are all executed.

sentences.zh: 諸挾仇故殺其從父，偶獲生免者，罪與已死同。

translations.literal: As to all who bearing a grudge intentionally kill their paternal uncle and by chance obtain life spared: the offense is the same as if he had died.
translations.idiomatic: Those who deliberately kill a paternal uncle in a grudge killing receive the same penalty as if the victim had died, even if he survives.

sentences.zh: 諸妻因爭殺其夫者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all wives who in a quarrel kill their husbands: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Wives who kill their husbands in a quarrel are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸婦人問醫人買毒藥殺其夫者，醫人同處死。

translations.literal: As to all women who ask a physician to buy poison to kill their husbands: the physician is executed together with them.
translations.idiomatic: Women who procure poison from a physician to kill their husbands are executed, and so is the physician.

sentences.zh: 諸妻殺傷其夫，幸獲生免者，同殺死論。

translations.literal: As to all wives who kill or injure their husbands and fortunately obtain life spared: sentenced the same as for killing to death.
translations.idiomatic: Wives who kill or injure their husbands are punished as for murder even if the husband survives.

sentences.zh: 諸婿因醉殺其婦翁，偶獲生免者，罪與已死同。

translations.literal: As to all sons-in-law who when drunk kill their fathers-in-law and by chance obtain life spared: the offense is the same as if he had died.
translations.idiomatic: Sons-in-law who kill their fathers-in-law while drunk receive the same penalty as if the victim had died, even if he survives.

sentences.zh: 諸奴殺傷本主者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all slaves who kill or injure their own masters: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Slaves who kill or injure their masters are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸奴詬詈其主不遜者，杖一百七，居役二年，役滿日歸其主。

translations.literal: As to all slaves who revile their masters insolently: beaten one hundred seven strokes, perform service for two years; on the day service is complete, return to the master.
translations.idiomatic: Slaves who insolently revile their masters receive one hundred seven strokes, two years of penal service, and are then returned to the master.

sentences.zh: 諸奴故殺其主者，淩遲處死。

translations.literal: As to all slaves who intentionally kill their masters: executed by dismemberment.
translations.idiomatic: Slaves who deliberately kill their masters suffer dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 諸奴毆死主婿者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all slaves who beat to death their master's son-in-law: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Slaves who beat their master's son-in-law to death are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸挾仇殺傷人一家，俱獲生免者，與已死同。

translations.literal: As to all who bearing a grudge kill or injure an entire household, all fortunately obtaining life spared: the same as if they had died.
translations.idiomatic: Those who in a grudge kill or injure an entire household receive the same penalty as if all had died, even if all survive.

sentences.zh: 其同謀悔過不至者，減等論。

translations.literal: Co-conspirators who repent and do not appear: sentence with reduced degree.
translations.idiomatic: Co-conspirators who repent and fail to appear receive reduced sentences.

sentences.zh: 諸以奸盡殺其母黨一家者，淩遲處死。

translations.literal: As to all who through adultery completely kill an entire household of their mother's kin: executed by dismemberment.
translations.idiomatic: Those who through an adulterous affair slaughter an entire household of their mother's kin suffer dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 諸兄挾仇，與子同謀殺其弟一家者，皆處死。

translations.literal: As to all elder brothers who bearing a grudge jointly plot with their sons to kill their younger brother's entire household: all are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Elder brothers who conspire with their sons to kill a younger brother's entire household in a grudge killing are all executed.

sentences.zh: 諸支解人，煮以為食者，以不道論，雖瘐死，仍征燒埋銀給苦主。

translations.literal: As to all who dismember a person and boil the flesh for food: sentenced as for unnatural conduct; even if they die of illness in prison, still levy silver for burning and burial to give the injured party.
translations.idiomatic: Those who dismember a person and boil the flesh for food are sentenced for unnatural conduct; even if they die in custody, burial compensation is levied for the victim's family.

sentences.zh: 諸魘魅大臣者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who employ sorcery against great ministers: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who use sorcery against great ministers are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸妻魘魅其夫，子魘魅其父，會大赦者，子流遠，妻從其夫嫁賣。

translations.literal: As to all wives who bewitch their husbands, or sons who bewitch their fathers: if a great amnesty is encountered, the son is exiled to a distant place; the wife is remarried or sold at her husband's family's discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Wives who bewitch their husbands or sons who bewitch their fathers: under a great amnesty the son is exiled and the wife is remarried or sold at her husband's family's discretion.

sentences.zh: 諸造蠱毒中人者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who manufacture gu poison to harm people: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who manufacture gu poison to harm others are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸采生人支解以祭鬼者，陵遲處死，仍沒其家產。

translations.literal: As to all who take living persons, dismember them, and sacrifice to ghosts: executed by dismemberment; still confiscate household property.
translations.idiomatic: Those who dismember living persons for ghost sacrifice suffer dismemberment and forfeiture of their property.

sentences.zh: 其同居家口，雖不知情，並徙遠方。

translations.literal: Co-resident household members, even if ignorant, are all exiled to a distant place.
translations.idiomatic: All co-resident household members are exiled afar, even if they were unaware.

sentences.zh: 已行而不曾殺人者，比強盜不曾傷人、不得財，杖一百七，徒三年。

translations.literal: If the act was carried out but no one was killed: compared with robbery in which no one was injured and no property was taken—beaten one hundred seven strokes, penal servitude three years.
translations.idiomatic: If the rite was performed but no one was killed, the penalty matches attempted robbery without injury or gain: one hundred seven strokes and three years of penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 謀而未行者，九十七，徒二年半。

translations.literal: If plotted but not carried out: ninety-seven strokes, penal servitude two and a half years.
translations.idiomatic: If the crime was plotted but not carried out: ninety-seven strokes and two and a half years of penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 其應死之人，能自首，或捕獲同罪者，給犯人家產，應捕者減半。

translations.literal: Persons liable to death who can surrender themselves or capture a co-offender of the same crime are given the offender's household property; authorized catchers receive half.
translations.idiomatic: Those liable to death who surrender or capture a co-offender receive the offender's property; authorized catchers receive half.

sentences.zh: ○奸非

translations.literal: ○ Adultery and illicit sexual relations
translations.idiomatic: ○ Adultery and Fornication

sentences.zh: 諸和奸者，杖七十七；

translations.literal: As to all consensual adultery: beaten seventy-seven strokes;
translations.idiomatic: Consensual adultery is punished with seventy-seven strokes of the staff;

sentences.zh: 有夫者，八十七。

translations.literal: if the woman has a husband: eighty-seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: if the woman has a husband, eighty-seven strokes.

sentences.zh: 誘奸婦逃者，加一等，男女罪同，婦人去衣受刑。

translations.literal: Those who seduce an adulteress to flee: increase one degree; man and woman punished alike; the woman is stripped for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Seducing a married woman to flee increases the penalty one degree; man and woman are punished alike, and the woman is stripped for the beating.

sentences.zh: 未成者，減四等。

translations.literal: If not completed: reduce four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: If the act was not completed, the penalty is reduced four degrees.

sentences.zh: 強奸有夫婦人者死，無夫者杖一百七，未成者減一等，婦人不坐。

translations.literal: Forcible violation of a married woman: death; if she has no husband: beaten one hundred seven strokes; if not completed, reduce one degree; the woman is not punished.
translations.idiomatic: Rape of a married woman is punishable by death; rape of an unmarried woman brings one hundred seven strokes; if incomplete, the penalty is reduced one degree; the woman is not punished.

sentences.zh: 其媒合及容止者，各減奸罪三等，止理見發之家，私和者減四等。

translations.literal: Brokers and those who harbor them: each reduce the adultery offense three degrees; only prosecute households where discovered; private settlement reduces four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Matchmakers and harborers each have the adultery penalty reduced three degrees; only discovered households are prosecuted; private settlement reduces the penalty four degrees.

sentences.zh: 諸指奸不坐。

translations.literal: As to all groundless accusations of adultery: no liability.
translations.idiomatic: Groundless accusations of adultery incur no liability.

sentences.zh: 諸無夫婦人有孕，稱與某人奸，即同指奸，罪止本婦。

translations.literal: As to all unmarried pregnant women who claim adultery with a certain man: the same as groundless accusation; punishment stops with the woman herself.
translations.idiomatic: Unmarried pregnant women who name a man as their lover are treated like false accusers, and only the woman is punished.

sentences.zh: 諸宿衛士與宮女奸者，出軍。

translations.literal: As to all palace guards who commit adultery with palace women: expelled from military service.
translations.idiomatic: Palace guards who commit adultery with palace women are expelled from service.

sentences.zh: 諸翁欺奸男婦，已成者處死，未成者杖一百七，男婦歸宗。

translations.literal: As to all fathers-in-law who deceive and violate their daughters-in-law: if completed, execution; if not completed, beaten one hundred seven strokes; the daughter-in-law returns to her natal family.
translations.idiomatic: Fathers-in-law who seduce or rape their daughters-in-law are executed if the act is completed, or beaten one hundred seven strokes if not, and the daughter-in-law returns to her natal family.

sentences.zh: 和奸者皆處死。

translations.literal: Those who consented to the adultery are all executed.
translations.idiomatic: All who consented to the adultery are executed.

sentences.zh: 男婦虛執翁奸已成，有司已加翁拷掠，男婦招虛者，處死；

translations.literal: If a daughter-in-law falsely claims the father-in-law's seduction was completed, and officials have already tortured the father-in-law, and the daughter-in-law confesses the claim was false: execution;
translations.idiomatic: If a daughter-in-law falsely claims completed seduction by her father-in-law, and after he has been tortured she confesses the accusation was false, she is executed;

sentences.zh: 虛執翁奸未成，已加翁拷掠，男婦招虛者，杖一百七，發付夫家從其嫁賣。

translations.literal: if she falsely claims seduction was not completed, and officials have already tortured the father-in-law, and the daughter-in-law confesses the claim was false: beaten one hundred seven strokes, sent to her husband's family for remarriage or sale at their discretion.
translations.idiomatic: if she falsely claims incomplete seduction and confesses after torture, she receives one hundred seven strokes and is sent to her husband's family for remarriage or sale.

sentences.zh: 婦告或翁告同。

translations.literal: Whether the wife accuses or the father-in-law accuses: the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: The same rule applies whether the wife or father-in-law brings the accusation.

sentences.zh: 若男婦告翁強奸已成，卻問得翁欲欺奸未成，男婦妄告重事，笞三十七，歸宗。

translations.literal: If a daughter-in-law accuses her father-in-law of completed forcible violation, but inquiry establishes he intended seduction that was not completed, and the daughter-in-law has falsely accused a grave matter: thirty-seven strokes of the bamboo, return to natal family.
translations.idiomatic: If a daughter-in-law accuses her father-in-law of completed rape but inquiry shows attempted seduction only, and she has falsely accused a grave offense, she receives thirty-seven strokes and returns to her natal family.

sentences.zh: 諸欺奸義男婦，杖一百七，欺奸不成，杖八十七，婦並不坐。

translations.literal: As to all who deceive and violate an adopted son's wife: beaten one hundred seven strokes; if seduction not completed, eighty-seven strokes; the woman is not punished.
translations.idiomatic: Deceiving and violating an adopted son's wife brings one hundred seven strokes; attempted seduction brings eighty-seven; the woman is not punished.

sentences.zh: 婦及其夫異居當差，雖會赦，仍異居。

translations.literal: The wife and her husband live separately and perform corvée duty; even if an amnesty is encountered, they still live separately.
translations.idiomatic: The wife and husband live separately and perform corvée duty; even under amnesty they remain separated.

sentences.zh: 諸男婦與奸夫謀誣翁欺奸，買休出離者，杖一百七，從夫嫁賣，奸夫減一等，買休錢沒官。

translations.literal: As to all daughters-in-law who with their lovers plot to falsely accuse the father-in-law of seduction and buy a divorce: beaten one hundred seven strokes, remarried or sold at husband's family's discretion; lover's penalty reduced one degree; divorce payment confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Daughters-in-law who conspire with lovers to falsely accuse a father-in-law and buy divorce receive one hundred seven strokes and are remarried or sold at the husband's family's discretion; the lover's penalty is reduced one degree and the payment is confiscated.

sentences.zh: 諸與弟妻奸者，各杖一百七，奸夫流遠，奸婦從夫所欲。

translations.literal: As to all who commit adultery with a younger brother's wife: each beaten one hundred seven strokes; the adulterer exiled to a distant place; the adulteress disposed of as her husband wishes.
translations.idiomatic: Adultery with a younger brother's wife brings one hundred seven strokes for each party; the man is exiled and the woman is disposed of as her husband wishes.

sentences.zh: 諸嫂寡守志，叔強奸者，杖九十七。

translations.literal: As to all widowed sisters-in-law who keep their chastity and are forcibly violated by their husband's younger brother: beaten ninety-seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: A widowed sister-in-law who keeps her chastity and is raped by her husband's younger brother brings ninety-seven strokes on the offender.

sentences.zh: 諸與同居侄婦奸，各杖一百七，有官者除名。

translations.literal: As to all who commit adultery with a co-resident nephew's wife: each beaten one hundred seven strokes; if either holds office, name removed.
translations.idiomatic: Adultery with a co-resident nephew's wife brings one hundred seven strokes for each party; any official involved is struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 諸強奸侄婦未成者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: As to all who forcibly violate a nephew's wife without completion: beaten one hundred seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Attempted rape of a nephew's wife brings one hundred seven strokes.

sentences.zh: 諸與兄弟之女奸，皆處死；

translations.literal: As to all who commit adultery with a brother's daughter: all are executed;
translations.idiomatic: Adultery with a brother's daughter is punishable by death for all parties;

sentences.zh: 與從兄弟之女奸，減一等；

translations.literal: adultery with a paternal cousin's daughter: reduce one degree;
translations.idiomatic: adultery with a paternal cousin's daughter carries a penalty reduced one degree;

sentences.zh: 與族兄弟之女奸，減二等。

translations.literal: adultery with a clan cousin's daughter: reduce two degrees.
translations.idiomatic: adultery with a more distant clan cousin's daughter carries a penalty reduced two degrees.

sentences.zh: 諸居父母喪欺奸父妾者，各杖九十七，婦人歸宗。

translations.literal: As to all who during mourning for parents deceive and violate a father's concubine: each beaten ninety-seven strokes; the woman returns to her natal family.
translations.idiomatic: During mourning for one's parents, deceiving and violating a father's concubine brings ninety-seven strokes for each party, and the woman returns to her natal family.

sentences.zh: 諸奸私再犯者，罪加二等，婦人聽其夫嫁賣。

translations.literal: As to all repeat private adultery: offense increased two degrees; the woman may be remarried or sold at her husband's discretion.
translations.idiomatic: A second private adultery offense increases the penalty two degrees, and the woman may be remarried or sold at her husband's discretion.

sentences.zh: 諸因奸偷遞家財，止以奸論。

translations.literal: As to all who through adultery secretly transfer household property: adjudicate only as adultery.
translations.idiomatic: Using an adulterous affair to steal household property is punished only as adultery.

sentences.zh: 諸雇人之妻為妾，年滿而歸，雇主復與通，即以奸論。

translations.literal: As to all who hire another man's wife as a concubine and, when her term ends and she returns home, the employer again has relations with her: adjudicate as adultery.
translations.idiomatic: Hiring another man's wife as a concubine and resuming relations after her term ends is treated as adultery.

sentences.zh: 因又與殺其夫者，皆處死。

translations.literal: If he then also joins in killing her husband: all are executed.
translations.idiomatic: If he then also joins in killing her husband, all are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸子犯奸，父出首，仍坐之，諸奸不理首原。

translations.literal: As to all sons who commit adultery and whose fathers report them: still punished; in all adultery cases voluntary surrender grants no clemency.
translations.idiomatic: Sons who commit adultery are still punished when their fathers report them; voluntary surrender grants no clemency in adultery cases.

sentences.zh: 諸奸生男女，男隨父，女隨母。

translations.literal: As to all children born of adultery: boys follow the father, girls follow the mother.
translations.idiomatic: Children born of adultery follow the father if male and the mother if female.

sentences.zh: 諸僧尼道士女冠犯奸，斷後並勒還俗，諸強奸人幼女者處死，雖和同強，女不坐。

translations.literal: As to all monks, nuns, Daoist priests, and female Daoist clerics who commit adultery: after sentencing all are compelled to return to secular life; as to all who forcibly violate young girls: execution; even if consensual, treat as forcible violation; the girl is not punished.
translations.idiomatic: Monks, nuns, and Daoist clerics who commit adultery must return to secular life after sentencing; rape of a young girl is punishable by death; even consensual relations with a young girl are treated as rape, and the girl is not punished.

sentences.zh: 凡稱幼女，止十歲以下。

translations.literal: Whenever 'young girl' is used, it refers only to those ten years of age and below.
translations.idiomatic: The term 'young girl' applies only to girls ten years of age and below.

sentences.zh: 諸年老奸人幼女，杖一百七，不聽贖。

translations.literal: As to all elderly persons who commit adultery with young girls: beaten one hundred seven strokes; redemption not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: An elderly person who commits adultery with a young girl receives one hundred seven strokes and may not redeem the penalty.

sentences.zh: 諸十五歲未成丁男，和奸十歲以下女，雖和同強，減死，杖一百七，女不坐。

translations.literal: As to all males of fifteen who have not reached adulthood who consensually commit adultery with girls ten and below: even if consensual, treat as forcible violation; death reduced; beaten one hundred seven strokes; the girl is not punished.
translations.idiomatic: A boy under fifteen who has not reached adulthood who has consensual relations with a girl ten or younger is treated as rape; death is commuted to one hundred seven strokes, and the girl is not punished.

sentences.zh: 諸強奸十歲以上女者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: As to all who forcibly violate girls ten years of age and above: beaten one hundred seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Forcible violation of a girl ten or older brings one hundred seven strokes.

sentences.zh: 諸強奸妻前夫男婦未成，及強奸妻前夫女已成，並杖一百七，妻離之。

translations.literal: As to all who forcibly violate a wife's former husband's daughter-in-law without completion, or forcibly violate his daughter with completion: in both cases beaten one hundred seven strokes; the wife divorces him.
translations.idiomatic: Attempted rape of a wife's former husband's daughter-in-law, or completed rape of his daughter, brings one hundred seven strokes in either case, and the wife divorces him.

sentences.zh: 諸三男強奸一婦者，皆處死，婦人不坐。

translations.literal: As to all cases where three men forcibly violate one woman: all are executed; the woman is not punished.
translations.idiomatic: If three men rape one woman, all are executed; the woman is not punished.

sentences.zh: 諸職官犯奸者，如常律，仍除名，但有祿人犯者同。

translations.literal: As to all officials who commit adultery: as under the ordinary statutes, still remove their names; salaried persons who commit the offense are treated the same.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who commit adultery are punished under the ordinary statutes and struck from the rolls; salaried persons are treated the same.

sentences.zh: 諸職官求奸未成者，笞五十七，解見任，雜職敘。

translations.literal: As to all officials who solicit adultery without completion: fifty-seven strokes of the bamboo, removed from current post, reassigned to minor post.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who solicit adultery without completion receive fifty-seven strokes, lose their current post, and are reassigned to a minor post.

sentences.zh: 諸職官因謔部民妻，致其夫棄妻者，杖六十七，罷職，降二等雜職敘，記過。

translations.literal: As to all officials who by jesting with a subject's wife cause her husband to abandon her: beaten sixty-seven strokes, dismissed, demoted two grades to minor post, offense recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Officials whose jesting with a subject's wife causes her husband to abandon her receive sixty-seven strokes, are dismissed, demoted two grades, and have the offense recorded.

sentences.zh: 諸職官強奸部民妻未成，杖一百七，除名不敘。

translations.literal: As to all officials who forcibly violate a subject's wife without completion: beaten one hundred seven strokes, name removed without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who attempt to rape a subject's wife receive one hundred seven strokes and are permanently struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 諸職官因奸，買部民妾，奸非奸所捕獲，止以買部民妾論，笞三十七，解職別敘。

translations.literal: As to all officials who through adultery purchase a subject's concubine, seized not in the act of adultery but on the charge of purchasing a subject's concubine: adjudicate only for purchasing; thirty-seven strokes of the bamboo, removed from office, reassigned elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who purchase a subject's concubine through an adulterous affair, seized on that charge rather than in the act, are punished only for the purchase with thirty-seven strokes, removal, and reassignment.

sentences.zh: 諸監臨官與所監臨囚人妻奸者，杖九十七，除名。

translations.literal: As to all supervising officials who commit adultery with the wife of a prisoner under their supervision: beaten ninety-seven strokes, name removed.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising officials who commit adultery with a prisoner's wife receive ninety-seven strokes and are struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 諸職官與倡優之妻奸，因娶為妾者，杖七十七，罷職不敘。

translations.literal: As to all officials who commit adultery with an entertainer's wife and then take her as concubine: beaten seventy-seven strokes, dismissed without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who commit adultery with an entertainer's wife and then take her as concubine receive seventy-seven strokes and are dismissed without reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 諸監臨令人奸汙所部寡婦者，杖八十七，除名。

translations.literal: As to all supervising officials who have another defile widows under their jurisdiction: beaten eighty-seven strokes, name removed.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising officials who have another man defile widows under their charge receive eighty-seven strokes and are struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 諸蠻夷官擅以籍沒婦人為妻者，杖八十七，罷職記過，婦人笞四十七。

translations.literal: As to all frontier officials who on their own authority take confiscated women as wives: beaten eighty-seven strokes, dismissed with offense recorded; the woman receives forty-seven strokes of the bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials who take confiscated women as wives on their own authority receive eighty-seven strokes and are dismissed with the offense recorded; the woman receives forty-seven strokes.

sentences.zh: 諸主奸奴妻者，不坐。

translations.literal: As to all masters who commit adultery with their slaves' wives: no liability.
translations.idiomatic: Masters who commit adultery with their slaves' wives incur no liability.

sentences.zh: 諸奴有女，已許嫁為良人妻，即為良人，其主輒欺奸者，杖一百七，其妻縱之者，笞五十七，其女夫家仍願為婚者，減元議財錢之半，不願者，追還元下聘財，令父收管，為良改嫁。

translations.literal: As to all slaves who have daughters already betrothed to commoners and thereby attaining commoner status: if the master forcibly deceives and violates her, beaten one hundred seven strokes; if his wife permitted it, fifty-seven strokes of the bamboo; if the fiancé's family still wishes the marriage, reduce half the agreed bride-price; if not, recover the betrothal gifts to the father's custody and remarry her as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: If a slave's daughter betrothed to a commoner is forcibly violated by her master, he receives one hundred seven strokes; if his wife permitted it, she receives fifty-seven; if the fiancé's family still wishes to marry, half the bride-price is remitted; if not, betrothal gifts return to her father and she may remarry as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸奴奸主女者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all slaves who commit adultery with their master's daughter: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Slaves who commit adultery with their master's daughter are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸以傔從與命婦奸，以命婦從奸夫逃者，皆處死。

translations.literal: As to all who use a servant to commit adultery with a noblewoman, or whose noblewoman flees with her lover: all are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Those who use a servant to commit adultery with a noblewoman, or whose noblewoman flees with her lover, are all executed.

sentences.zh: 諸強奸主妻者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who forcibly violate their master's wife: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who rape their master's wife are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸奴與主妾奸者，各杖九十七。

translations.literal: As to all slaves who commit adultery with their master's concubine: each beaten ninety-seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Slaves who commit adultery with their master's concubine each receive ninety-seven strokes.

sentences.zh: 諸良民竊奴婢生子，子隨母還主，奴竊良民生子，子隨母為良，仍異籍當差。

translations.literal: As to all cases where a commoner secretly has relations with a slave or maid and bears a child: the child follows the mother and returns to the master; where a slave secretly has relations with a commoner and bears a child: the child follows the mother and becomes a commoner, registered separately for corvée duty.
translations.idiomatic: If a commoner secretly has relations with a slave and bears a child, the child follows the mother and returns to the master; if a slave has relations with a commoner, the child follows the mother, becomes a commoner, and is registered separately for corvée.

sentences.zh: 諸奴婢相奸，笞四十七。

translations.literal: As to all slaves and maids who commit adultery with one another: forty-seven strokes of the bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: Adultery between slaves or maids brings forty-seven strokes for each party.

sentences.zh: 諸夫受財，縱妻為倡者，夫及奸婦、奸夫各杖八十七，離之。

translations.literal: As to all husbands who accept payment and allow their wives to become prostitutes: husband, adulteress, and adulterer each beaten eighty-seven strokes; divorce.
translations.idiomatic: Husbands who accept payment and allow their wives to prostitute themselves bring eighty-seven strokes on the husband, woman, and lover, and the marriage is dissolved.

sentences.zh: 若夫受財，勒妻妾為倡者，妻量情論罪。

translations.literal: If a husband accepts payment and compels his wife or concubine to become a prostitute: the wife is sentenced according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: If a husband accepts payment and compels his wife or concubine to prostitute herself, the wife is sentenced according to the circumstances.

sentences.zh: 諸和奸，同謀以財買休，卻娶為妻者，各杖九十七，奸婦歸其夫。

translations.literal: As to all consensual adultery where the parties jointly plot to buy a divorce with money and then marry one another: each beaten ninety-seven strokes; the adulteress returns to her husband.
translations.idiomatic: In consensual adultery where the parties buy a divorce and then marry, each receives ninety-seven strokes and the adulteress returns to her husband.

sentences.zh: 諸夫妻不睦，夫以威虐，逼其妻指與人奸者，杖七十七，妻不坐，離之。

translations.literal: As to all cases where husband and wife are not harmonious and the husband by coercion and abuse compels his wife to falsely accuse another of adultery: beaten seventy-seven strokes; the wife is not punished; divorce.
translations.idiomatic: Husbands who coerce their wives into false adultery accusations receive seventy-seven strokes; the wife is not punished, and they divorce.

sentences.zh: 諸婿誣妻父與女奸者，杖九十七，妻離之。

translations.literal: As to all sons-in-law who falsely accuse their wives' fathers of incest with their daughters: beaten ninety-seven strokes; the wife divorces him.
translations.idiomatic: Sons-in-law who falsely accuse their fathers-in-law of incest with their daughters receive ninety-seven strokes, and the wife divorces him.

sentences.zh: 諸夫指奸而棄其妻，所指奸夫輒停妻而娶之者，兩離之。

translations.literal: As to all cases where a husband abandons his wife on a charge of adultery and the accused man sets aside his own wife to marry her: both marriages are dissolved.
translations.idiomatic: If a husband abandons his wife for adultery and the accused man divorces his own wife to marry her, both marriages are dissolved.

sentences.zh: 諸奸夫奸婦同謀殺其夫者，皆處死，仍於奸夫家屬征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: As to all adulterers and adulteresses who jointly plot to kill her husband: all are executed; still levy burial compensation silver from the adulterer's family.
translations.idiomatic: Adulterers and adulteresses who conspire to kill her husband are all executed, and burial compensation is levied from the adulterer's family.

sentences.zh: 諸因奸殺其本夫，奸婦不知情，以減死論。

translations.literal: As to all who through adultery kill their own husband while the adulteress did not know: sentence with death reduced.
translations.idiomatic: If a man kills his wife's husband through adultery without the adulteress's knowledge, the penalty is reduced from death.

sentences.zh: 諸妻與人奸，同謀藥死其夫，偶獲生免者，罪與已死同，依例結案。

translations.literal: As to all wives who commit adultery with another and jointly plot to poison their husbands, fortunately obtaining life spared: the offense is the same as if he had died; close the case according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Wives who commit adultery and conspire to poison their husbands receive the same penalty as if he had died even if he survives, and the case is closed according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 諸婦人為首，與眾奸夫同謀，親殺其夫者，陵遲處死，奸夫同謀者如常法。

translations.literal: As to all women who take the lead, jointly plotting with several adulterers to kill their husbands with their own hands: executed by dismemberment; co-conspiring adulterers are punished according to the ordinary law.
translations.idiomatic: Women who lead several lovers in killing their husbands with their own hands suffer dismemberment; co-conspiring lovers are punished under the ordinary statutes.

sentences.zh: 諸夫獲妻奸，妻拒捕，殺之無罪。

translations.literal: As to all husbands who catch their wives in adultery and the wife resists arrest, and he kills her: no guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Husbands who catch their wives in adultery and kill them while they resist arrest are not guilty.

sentences.zh: 諸與無夫婦奸，約為妻，卻毆死正妻者，處死。

translations.literal: As to all who commit adultery with a woman without a husband, promise to make her wife, but then beat their principal wife to death: execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who commit adultery with an unmarried woman, promise to marry her, but then beat their principal wife to death are executed.

sentences.zh: 諸與奸婦同謀藥死其正妻者，皆處死。

translations.literal: As to all who jointly plot with an adulteress to poison their principal wife to death: all are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Those who conspire with an adulteress to poison their principal wife to death are all executed.

sentences.zh: 諸妻妾與人奸，夫於奸所殺其奸夫及其妻妾，及為人妻殺其強奸之夫，並不坐。

translations.literal: As to all wives and concubines who commit adultery with another: if the husband kills the adulterer and his wife or concubine at the scene of adultery, and if a wife kills the man who raped her, none is guilty.
translations.idiomatic: When a wife or concubine commits adultery, a husband who kills both the lover and the adulteress at the scene is not guilty; nor is a wife who kills the man who raped her.

sentences.zh: 若於奸所殺其奸夫，而妻妾獲免，殺其妻妾，而奸夫獲免者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: If at the scene of adultery he kills the adulterer while the wife or concubine escapes, or kills the wife or concubine while the adulterer escapes: beaten one hundred seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: If a husband kills the adulterer at the scene but the wife or concubine escapes, or kills the wife or concubine while the adulterer escapes, he receives one hundred seven strokes of the staff.

sentences.zh: 諸奸夫殺死奸婦者，與故殺常人同。

translations.literal: As to all adulterers who kill the adulteress: the same as premeditated murder of an ordinary person.
translations.idiomatic: Adulterers who kill their lovers are punished the same as those who deliberately murder an ordinary person.

sentences.zh: 諸求奸不從，毆死其婦，以強盜持仗殺人論。

translations.literal: As to all who seek adultery and, when refused, beat their wife to death: sentenced as for an armed robber who kills.
translations.idiomatic: Those who demand adultery and, when refused, beat their wife to death are sentenced as armed robbers who kill.

sentences.zh: 諸兩奸夫與一奸婦皆有宿約，其先至者因鬥殺其後至者，以故殺論。

translations.literal: As to all cases where two adulterers and one adulteress all had a prior tryst, and the one who arrived first kills the later arrival in a fight: sentenced as premeditated murder.
translations.idiomatic: When two lovers and one adulteress all had a standing arrangement and the first to arrive kills the later one in a fight, the killer is sentenced for premeditated murder.

sentences.zh: ○盜賊

translations.literal: ○ Robbers and thieves
translations.idiomatic: ○ Robbers and Thieves

sentences.zh: 諸盜賊共盜者，並贓論，仍以造意之人為首，隨從者各減一等。

translations.literal: As to all who jointly steal: all are sentenced according to the loot; still, the instigator is treated as the principal offender, and each follower is reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Joint thieves are all sentenced according to the stolen goods, with the instigator treated as the ringleader and each accomplice punished one degree lighter.

sentences.zh: 或二罪以上俱發，從其重得論之。

translations.literal: If two or more offenses arise together, sentence according to the heavier offense.
translations.idiomatic: When two or more offenses arise together, the heavier penalty applies.

sentences.zh: 諸竊盜初犯，刺左臂，謂已得財者。

translations.literal: As to all petty thieves on a first offense: tattoo the left arm—meaning when property has actually been obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Petty thieves on a first offense are tattooed on the left arm, provided they have actually obtained property.

sentences.zh: 再犯刺右臂，三犯刺項。

translations.literal: On a second offense tattoo the right arm; on a third offense tattoo the neck.
translations.idiomatic: A second offense is tattooed on the right arm, and a third on the neck.

sentences.zh: 強盜初犯刺項，並充警跡人，官司以法拘檢關防之。

translations.literal: On a first offense of robbery tattoo the neck, and also assign the offender as a reserve thief-catcher; the authorities shall lawfully detain, inspect, and guard him.
translations.idiomatic: First-time robbers are tattooed on the neck, assigned as reserve thief-catchers, and kept under lawful detention and surveillance by the authorities.

sentences.zh: 其蒙古人有犯，及婦人犯者，不在刺字之例。

translations.literal: If Mongols commit the offense, and when women commit the offense, they are not subject to tattooing.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols and women are not subject to tattooing.

sentences.zh: 諸評盜贓者，皆以至元鈔為則，除正贓外，仍追倍贓。

translations.literal: As to all who assess stolen goods: all use Zhiyuan notes as the standard; besides the principal loot, double restitution is still pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Stolen goods are assessed in Zhiyuan notes; beyond returning the principal loot, double restitution is still required.

sentences.zh: 其有未獲賊人，及雖獲無可追償，並於有者名下追征。

translations.literal: If the thief has not yet been caught, or though caught nothing can be recovered for restitution, collection is still made from those who have assets.
translations.idiomatic: If the thief is not caught, or nothing can be recovered from him once caught, restitution is still levied from those who have assets.

sentences.zh: 諸犯徒者，徒一年，杖六十七；

translations.literal: As to all who incur penal servitude: one year, beaten sixty-seven strokes;
translations.idiomatic: Those sentenced to penal servitude receive accompanying beatings: one year, sixty-seven strokes;

sentences.zh: 一年半，杖七十七；

translations.literal: one and a half years, beaten seventy-seven strokes;
translations.idiomatic: one and a half years, seventy-seven strokes;

sentences.zh: 二年，杖八十七；

translations.literal: two years, beaten eighty-seven strokes;
translations.idiomatic: two years, eighty-seven strokes;

sentences.zh: 二年半，杖九十七；

translations.literal: two and a half years, beaten ninety-seven strokes;
translations.idiomatic: two and a half years, ninety-seven strokes;

sentences.zh: 三年，杖一百七。

translations.literal: three years, beaten one hundred seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: three years, one hundred seven strokes.

sentences.zh: 皆先決訖，然後發遣合屬，帶鐐居役。

translations.literal: In all cases the beating is carried out first; only then is the offender sent to the appropriate jurisdiction to serve in shackles.
translations.idiomatic: In every case the beating is inflicted first; only then is the offender sent to the appropriate jurisdiction to serve in shackles.

sentences.zh: 應配役人，隨有金銀銅鐵洞冶、屯田、堤岸、橋道一切等處就作，令人監視，日計工程，滿日放還，充警跡人。

translations.literal: Those assigned to penal labor shall work wherever gold, silver, copper, iron, mining, garrison farming, dikes, bridges, roads, and all such projects exist; they are placed under supervision, work is counted by the day, and when the term is complete they are released and assigned as reserve thief-catchers.
translations.idiomatic: Those assigned to penal labor work at whatever mines, garrison farms, dikes, bridges, and roads are available, under daily supervision; when the term is complete they are released and assigned as reserve thief-catchers.

sentences.zh: 諸盜未發而自首者，原其罪；

translations.literal: As to all thieves who surrender themselves before the crime is discovered: their offense is forgiven;
translations.idiomatic: Thieves who surrender before the crime is discovered are forgiven;

sentences.zh: 能捕獲同伴者，仍依例給賞。
